BMW Atlas Hub is a design-stage project with no runnable collector. For sensitive reports, use the security contact in SECURITY.md instead of this public form. Do not include credentials, VINs, location history, or account data.

## Problem or question

Describe the decision needed or the documentation that needs correcting.

## Proposal and alternatives

Explain the proposed change and any tradeoffs.

## Evidence

Link supporting references. State their dates and context, and distinguish observed behaviour from assumptions. Use synthetic examples only.
